sources.quote: We are also releasing Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini to developers through our new enterprise API platform later this month.
sources.supports: xAI announced Grok-2 API availability, but this announcement does not state its API token prices or caching prices.

notes: The available primary announcement confirms API availability but gives no pricing, and the available xAI pricing documentation does not establish historical Grok-2 rates. The Internet Archive CDX request for historical pricing snapshots timed out, so the evidence does not determine whether the earlier rate was official or when cache pricing took effect.
